title.label: Great at coordinating care across multiple people

content.label:
Caring Village makes coordinating care across multiple people super easy. Schedules, medications, and updates are all centralized so you’re not chasing texts, emails, or trying to remember who said what. It’s simple to use, which matters when the last thing you need is another complicated system.

What’s made the biggest difference for us is staying connected as a family. We have people in different states, and this keeps everyone in the loop without constant check-ins or confusion.

It's the best app there is for this kind of thing right now.
This app is so helpful and a life changer!
I’ve been waiting for something like this and it’s just so well done. So thankful. Good job.

title.label: A simple tool that made caregiving easier!

content.label:
Caring for a loved one can feel overwhelming, but Caring Village has made it so much more manageable. Everything is in one place—appointments, updates, and communication—so nothing gets missed.

It’s helped our family stay organized and connected during a really emotional time, and that peace of mind is everything.

Highly recommend if you’re navigating caregiving.

Caring Village makes it easy to stay organized and keep everyone on the same page. Sharing updates, schedules, and tasks is simple and intuitive. It really relieves the stress from caregiving. Definitely recommend if you’re coordinating care with family or friends.

We set up Caring Village for my family of 8 siblings to help monitor and manage our parent’s health. This site has everything we need and is so simple to use on your laptop, iPad or phone. The journal feature allows each of us to capture with our visits or calls with our parents to share with the family current health issues or follow up from doctor’s appointments. It’s so much better than just texting each other. We also use the Calendar feature to track appointments so that one of us can join them in person or on a call to make sure we capture all the notes for reference. The ability to upload documents and maintain all the information on each of their various Drs makes it really easy for us to coordinate. Most importantly, the team at Caring Village, particularly Linda, has been amazingly responsive whenever we needed clarify a process or make suggestions for improvements. Caring Village has been absolutely perfect for our family to be actively engaged in our parents health.

I’m very grateful for the Caring Village team and their support. Having REAL PEOPLE available who were quickly responsive and helpful as I navigated the platform was very reassuring! The site itself is thoughtfully organized and clearly built to support families coordinating care.

They thought of everything!  An absolutely divine and must-have tool for families separated by distance while co-caring for loved ones.  Everyone knows what’s going on and is on the same page.  What a relief.  Thank you Caring Village!!
So wonderful to have an app that allows you and your family to get the care you need for a family member on multiple levels.

title.label: This app carried me through one of the hardest seasons of my life

content.label:
I spent the last few years caring for my mom while she was living with stage 4 lung cancer. Nothing truly prepares you for how overwhelming caregiving becomes — emotionally, physically, and mentally. Every day felt like a juggling act: driving back and forth for chemotherapy, managing medications, updating advance medical directives, coordinating travel so she could see friends and family, scheduling physical therapy, managing oxygen equipment, dealing with insurance and deductibles, and trying to secure medical appointments months in advance.

It was exhausting. And often, it felt very lonely.

Caring Village brought calm and clarity into a situation that otherwise felt like constant chaos. The medication management section alone was a godsend — one less thing to keep in my head when I was already running on fumes. Having a shared calendar to coordinate tasks gave structure to days that felt overwhelming, and being able to communicate with the caregiver we hired in the later months — all in one place — made an enormous difference.

What mattered most was the peace of mind. Caring Village helped me feel supported, organized, and less alone at a time when everything felt heavy. It dramatically lowered my stress and allowed me to be more present with my mom, instead of constantly worrying about what I might be forgetting.

This app is clearly built by people who understand caregiving not as a checklist, but as a deeply human experience. I’m profoundly grateful it existed when I needed it most.

Thank you, Caring Village.

This has been a game changer for my life. I have been balancing care for elderly in-laws and my special needs child. Too much. To keep up with own my own. This app helps keep me organized and helps keep everyone invested up to date with what going on with our loved one. It also makes asking for help so much easier.

title.label: The App we have been looking for

content.label: This is an amazing app!! Caring Village eliminates the stress of manually making sure everyone knows what the person’s needs are and ensures medication is given at correct times.  A definite game changer in taking care of your loved ones!!

My family uses Caring Village every day. It is so convenient to have everything we need in one place. It has saved us numerous times and makes managing the care for our special needs Grandson so much easier. Thank you Caring Vilage!
The Caring Village app has made my life so much easier as I can document my healthcare visits and information. Highly recommend this as it is well put together.

I highly recommend Caring Village for families to use when coming together in care of a loved one. I never got to use all of its vast capabilities with mom passing so fast, but I was able to see the value in this app for the short time I did use it. It was helpful managing her medical documentation as well. I can see how it can help families navigate caring for family members tremendously.

I wish a tool like this was around when I was navigating the unfamiliar and difficult world of caregiving for a sick parent. Great idea to have everything centralized and easily accessible to everyone in your “village.” This will help a lot of people.

I’m just starting the journey of caring for my elderly mother and it is daunting, even for a health professional like me.  Caring Village is an excellent app that acts as the central hub for coordinating the care of a loved one.  Appointments, meds, advice, health status — everyone in the family (or whomever you specify) can go and check what’s going on by using the Caring Village app.  It is also a great place to learn about all the myriad resources available out there because we can’t do it alone.  Thank you Caring Village for being there for us every step of the way.

Really loved what they have done with this app in its latest version. Wonderful interface and easy to use whether you are medically inclined or not. Great to share with family and get everyone aligned. It’s nice to see developers getting into this space cause it really needs help and support for a growing segment of the population. Looking forward to more advances by this app!

The initial reaction was very positive albeit there were numerous functional issues. But a couple of weeks after inviting members and uploading documents, members reported not being able to access the site. When I as administrator checked, I received notification that I needed to upgrade and pay in order to have more than TWO members, ie administrator plus one. I was never notified that there were any tiers nor restrictions on use. Now all the uploaded documents have disappeared and the work that all of us contributed is gone.

title.label: I can't imagine caring for a loved one without this app!

content.label: Being able to use the app to coordinate various activities and responsibilities while caring for my father with dementia made things so much easier for us during this difficult time.

Really want this one to work, has almost all the features I’m looking for. Most disappointing is how poorly the calendar (doesn’t) work. Fix the calendar connection and it has the potential to be great!
Trying to create a task, just didn’t work
This is very helpful and highly functional app to keep everything in one place. Great tool to have handy.

title.label: This app right what I need

content.label: I am so happy I came across this app. I am still learning how to use it but I am pleased with what I see so far, exactly what I was looking for - rich funtionality, great user experience and seperior customer service! I simply love it!

title.label: A Lifesaver for Families and Caregivers

content.label:
Caring Village has been such a game changer for our family. It keeps everyone on the same page — from appointments and medications to simple check-ins — all in one place. I love how easy it is to share updates and feel connected, even when we can’t be together.

It’s clear this app was designed by people who truly understand what caregivers go through. The layout is simple, the tools are practical, and it brings real peace of mind during stressful times.

If you’re caring for an aging parent or loved one, Caring Village is an absolute must. It’s thoughtful, easy to use, and genuinely helps lighten the load.

I used this app a couple years ago, and it was excellent.  As things progressed with my dad, unfortunately, the time passed where we used it actively.  A couple years later we are now caring for our mom, and so we immediately knew where to go.  Caring Village keeps us connected.  The app is great -- easy to use, and it clearly was built to do the things we need the most.  The name is right on -- it does take a Village to care for a family member, particularly as they become ill as a senior.  The various doctors, hospitals, EMRs (electronic med records), patient portals, pharmacies, etc. all seem to have their own way of doing things, and if there's one MAJOR lesson I've learned ... it's up to the family to play quarterback.  If we don't do it, then it doesn't get done.  Caring Village has been a tool that allows us to do that a lot easier, and for me and my 2 brothers to stay connected (the 3 of us are the key members of the village honestly, but docs and other folks are extended village members to us).  5 stars, and thank you Caring Village!

What an amazing app for caregivers!  Everything you need all in one place.  Reminders for meds, area for tasks and to dos that can be delegated to others, information on proper paperwork to have in place, and even an AI capability to ask pertinent questions regarding care.  I love it!  What will they think of next?  Oh and the support team is very helpful and efficient.  Thank you Caring Village team for making our lives easier!

If you want to keep track of ANY care journey for a loved one this is so easy to use. We all need a network of people following our care and this eliminates so much back and forth. It allows you to put together a care plan and simply ask the app if the care plan tasks have been completed. The new AI feature is a game changer!

I really like the app. I find it helpful to keep all my husbands family updated on how he is doing without having to repeat myself over and over. I do wish that the wellness entries would stay viewable no matter how long ago they were written. I find that when I send the email to family and friends to join it does not always work.

I think this app must require an update. I am unable to sign up due to the interface blocking everything with the keyboard. As soon as I try to enter my information the keyboard covers the screen and it’s impossible to hide the keyboard in order to enter the next required info, email, first and last name, password… etc. looks like a good idea but hey… update it to work with current Apple iOS?
This app is has great features but is often unresponsive
Wonderful
Provides what we need and has been fairly easy to set up. Only thing on my wish list would be to be able to rearrange the dashboard. Some of the options aren’t a priority over appointments, etc.

I would give this app a 4+, but it’s only a 3.2 star rating. I’ve been using this app for 1.5 years to keep track of my mother-in-law’s appointments. However, I can’t find any past the last 10 entries. Where do they go? How is this helping me keep track of what her doctors have done? Very frustrating. I’d like an answer please.

This app is not user friendly at all. Typing in the journal or responding to journal entries is practically impossible, considering you can only see the first few lines you type- so good luck reviewing before posting. This app has only added stress to an already stressful situation.

title.label: Ok but doesn’t help for things that are necessary to track medically

content.label:
Been trying to find an app that can do what Walmart wellness/CareZone did.  Wish the calendar appts would go to everyone in inner circles category instead of only to the person assigned.  Family needs to have all appts go to their calendars so they can track outside of the ap. Plus, if you make a change it doesn’t update your calendar but adds a new entry.  Controls for date and time are also finicky.
No trackers for weight/bp/sugar level/food or fluid intake.  No allergy list.
Great idea for contacts but should integrate it with the calendar appts because it’s frustrating to have to enter every detail for each dr appt when they are already in the contacts list.
Also no way to print/export the med list and you have to go into each one to see the details.

I can see the potential in this app and if it could add the features like Walmart wellness/care zone now that they have shut down that ap, this one could be the number 1 app for true family/care giver info sharing

Couldn't copy paste secure password in when creating account.  
Couldn't choose time zone when creating "village" account.  
Since I couldn't move forward and my xword wasn't secure enough (was going try to change once in app), I deleted and gave up.
But, definitely need to update with msg notifications rather than just email only.

The app serves it’s function.  Problem I’ve been having is reaching customer support. It can be several days before you get a reply through Chat box and when I do get a reply, it’s the same answer/directions which do not help solve the problem where a family member cannot join. Unfortunately, there is no number to call. 
Also, when a member adds something to the calendar, you get an alert of the addition, but the alert does not show the date.

Solid app. Like the daily care plan that reloads the same tasks each day and the to do list that’s just random stuff that needs to be done once. That’s a key differentiator. Didn’t see others with the option. 

Would be good to have option to set EACH task to weekly or daily, nut just the overall task list.

Would be good to have a place to track health metrics like weight, blood pressure, blood sugar and “other- user defined” which can be graphed.  Would be good to allow the health data to be written in from other apps.

title.label: Great app but could use updates.

content.label:
I would be willing to pay for this app if it had some updates. I would like to get phone alerts instead of email only when someone posts in the app.  

I would like the option of posting multiple photos in the wellness journal and the ability to scroll down while entering text. 

A photo option in messages would also be helpful. 

A dynamic calendar with color options would also be nice.   

I love this app I just wish it had more.

I am a geriatric care manager and I discovered this app when I was trying to juggle communication among 30+ family members for one of my clients. I since have started several more “villages” for other clients and use most of the available options. Overall I love this app. I have the following observations to share in hopes it helps people make a decision about using this and also in hopes the developers are reading reviews

Pros: 
-ability to care plan and have staff document daily in the wellness journal to monitor compliance and communicate with family. 
-ability to message multiple people at once
-family and client ability to remain updated on status and keep all involved in the loop consistently 
-family ability to ask questions, send messages, add items to the calendar, etc. it promotes transparency among family, client and care team
-ability to use calendar to schedule staff and appointments. Also able to assign staff to tasks and ask for volunteer from family at times there is no staff in the home

Cons:
-friends can see most of what the inner circle sees. This poses a privacy issue for those not given authorization to see medical and clinical details. I have had to minimize information shared and can’t fully use the app in one of my cases
-inability to archive closed cases for future reference. They can only be deleted
-the care plan is only good for one day then disappears. From an agency perspective this limits our ability to do quality assurance and track trends
-notifications to email only link to the site but not the actual action it is notifying about so it takes extra time to locate what has been added
-inability to retract a message or edit
-support is quick to respond and helpful. However when I asked to whom I could direct my recommendations to I got no response. I’m hoping this review may get into the proper hands to address some of these suggestions for improvements 

Despite the “cons”,  have adopted used of this app for all of my clients receiving in-home care and feel it meets most of our needs.

This app has been a lifeline for me as a caregiver relying information to family. I love the ability to leave notes for the family to check in on. I would suggest a new method to invite people to join. One family member has issues using email so hasn’t joined the village. We have been using this for over a year with no issues so thank you! 😇🙏🏼

I downloaded this app in preparation for surgery. I sent the appropriate links to my friends and family. No one of them was able to use it. Most people couldn’t even sign in and when they could the calendar/scheduling function was a total fail. 
Their customer service is also pretty nonexistent. I do not recommend it.

title.label: Great but I wish it had 2 more features

content.label:
This is a great app for the whole family to help my grandpa. I wish it kept pending volunteer requests on the dashboard and while you can have repeating events you can’t have more than one person sign up. For example, we have a recurring event to take him to the store. It would be great to be given the option to claim one or all recurring events.

It would be really helpful to have the ability to print the calendar for the elderly family member.

Great site to share care plan, documents, contacts, calendar and more. It’s perfect for us 5 siblings to coordinate care for our dad. Biggest issue is “friends” and “inner circle” can see almost everything. I was going to upload my dad’s medical cards, Medicare Card, etc, but realized friends and inner circle can see them as well. I find this very intrusive. There’s absolutely no need for anyone else to see private documents. Therefore, the cousins we invited had to be cancelled or revoked. My advice to the developers is to allow the administrators to pick and choose categories for each group type to see. For example, friends can only read Wellness Journal, and inner circle can see that plus a couple other categories such as meds, calendar, messages. Until this happens, we’re just keeping this between the siblings.

I briefly tried out to other apps and this one seems to be more intuitive and easier to use than others. Two complaints I have right now are – if someone makes a typo in their group message and doesn’t see it till later there doesn’t appear to be a way to edit or delete that message. This ability would make Messages more efficient. Second complaint is – there are no sounds or notifications coming through on my iPhone so I’m not aware that someone has made an entry or left a message until I go check manually.

I have been using this app for about a month now with my grandma, for whom I’m providing care. It has a ton of great features and allows you to communicate with a team effortlessly. This app is a total lifesaver!
Calendar doesn’t open and freezes the app on iphone7. Please fix ASAP!!!!!

Love this app so far - from a developer perspective, it makes great use of hot alerts and is super clean and easy to read. Only complaint is that after a save, the page doesn't reload with the new info and if you try to navigate to another page after the save, the app crashes. Small bugs that can be fixed quickly though.
